## What it is

Number 4, rendered orange. Back-right, 45°. Recessed 4. Three openings: 40, 66 and 92 mm. Not the start of the coil.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side, flat face down. The C is cut into the inner face of the bar.
- The foot tab is the same 6.0 × 3.2 mm section as the other three.

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up.
